purpose: What on Earth am I here for?

group.title: It All Starts with God
group.point: It’s not about me.
group.question: In spite of all the advertising around me, how can I remind myself that life is really about living for God, not myself?

group.title: You Are Not an Accident
group.point: I am not an accident.
group.question: I know that God uniquely created me. What areas of my personality, background, and physical appearance am I struggling to accept?

group.title: What Drives Your Life?
group.point: Living on purpose is the path to peace.
group.question: What would my family and friends say is the driving force of my life? What do I want it to be?

group.title: Made to Last Forever
group.point: There is more to life than just the here and now.
group.question: Since I was made to last forever, what is the one thing I should stop doing and the one thing I should start doing today?

group.title: Seeing Life from God's View
group.point: Life is a test and a trust.
group.question: What has happened to me recently that I now realize was a test from God? What are the greatest matters God has entrusted to me?

group.title: Life is a Temporary Assignment
group.point: This world is not my home.
group.question: How should the fact that life on earth is just a temporary assignment change the way I am living right now?

group.title: The Reason for Everything
group.point: It’s all for him.
group.question: Where in my daily routine can I become more aware of God’s glory?

purpose: You Were Planned for God’s Pleasure

group.title: Planned for God’s Pleasure
group.point: I was planned for God’s pleasure.
group.question: What common task could I start doing as if I were doing it directly for Jesus?

group.title: What Makes God Smile?
group.point: God smiles when I trust him.
group.question: Since God knows what is best, in what areas of my life do I need to trust him most?

group.title: The Heart of Worship
group.point: The heart of worship is surrender.
group.question: What area of my life am I holding back from God?

group.title: Becoming Best Friends with God
group.point: God wants to be my best friend.
group.question: What can I do to remind myself to think about God and talk to him more often throughout the day?

group.title: Developing Your Friendship with God
group.point: I’m as close to God as I choose to be.
group.question: What practical choices will I make today in order to grow closer to God?

group.title: Worship That Pleases God
group.point: God wants all of me.
group.question: Which is more pleasing to God right now — my public worship or my private worship? What will I do about this?

group.title: When God Seems Distant
group.point: God is real, no matter how I feel.
group.question: How can I stay focused on God’s presence, especially when he feels distant?

purpose: You Were Formed for God’s Family

group.title: Formed For God’s Family
group.point: I was formed for God’s family.
group.question: How can I start treating other believers like members of my own family?

group.title: What Matters Most
group.point: Life is all about love.
group.question: Are relationships my first priority? How can I ensure that they are?

group.title: A Place to Belong
group.point: I am called to belong, not just believe.
group.question: Does my level of involvement in my local church demonstrate that I love and am committed to God’s family?

group.title: Experiencing Life Together
group.point: I need others in my life.
group.question: What one step can I take today to connect with another believer at a more genuine, heart-to-heart level?

group.title: Cultivating Community
group.point: Community requires commitment.
group.question: How can I help cultivate today the characteristics of real community in my small group and my church?

group.title: Restoring Broken Fellowship
group.point: Relationships are always worth restoring.
group.question: Who do I need to restore a broken relationship with today?

group.title: Protecting Your Church
group.point: It is my responsibility to protect the unity of my church.
group.question: What am I personally doing to protect unity in my church family right now?

purpose: You Were Created to Become Like Christ

group.title: Created to Become Like Christ
group.point: I was created to become like Christ.
group.question: In what area of my life do I need to ask for the Spirit’s power to be like Christ today?

group.title: How We Grow
group.point: It is never too late to start growing.
group.question: What is one area where I need to stop thinking my way and start thinking God’s way?

group.title: Transformed by Truth
group.point: The truth transforms me.
group.question: What has God already told me in his Word that I haven’t started doing yet?

group.title: Transformed by Trouble
group.point: There is a purpose behind every problem.
group.question: What problem in my life has caused the greatest growth in me?

group.title: Growing through Temptation
group.point: Every temptation is an opportunity to do good.
group.question: What Christlike character quality can I develop by defeating the most common temptation I face?

group.title: Defeating Temptation
group.point: There is always a way out.
group.question: Who could I ask to be a spiritual partner to help me defeat a persistent temptation by praying for me?

group.title: It Takes Time
group.point: There are no shortcuts to maturity.
group.question: In what area of my spiritual growth do I need to be more patient and persistent?

purpose: You Were Shaped for Serving God

group.title: Accepting Your Assignment
group.point: Service is not optional.
group.question: What is holding me back from accepting God’s call to serve him?

group.title: Shaped for Serving God
group.point: I was shaped for serving God.
group.question: In what way can I see myself passionately serving others and loving it?

group.title: Understanding Your Shape
group.point: Nobody else can be me.
group.question: What God-given ability or personal experience can I offer to my church?

group.title: Using What God Gave You
group.point: God deserves my best.
group.question: How can I make the best use of what God has given me?

group.title: How Real Servants Act
group.point: I serve God by serving others.
group.question: Which of the six characteristics of a real servant offers the greatest challenge to me?

group.title: Thinking Like a Servant
group.point: To be a servant I must think like a servant.
group.question: Am I usually more concerned about being served or finding ways to serve others?

group.title: God’s Power in Your Weakness
group.point: God works best when I admit my weakness.
group.question: Am I limiting God’s power in my life by trying to hide my weaknesses? What do I need to be honest about in order to help others?

purpose: You Were Made for a Mission

group.title: Made for a Mission
group.point: I was made for a mission.
group.question: What fears have kept me from fulfilling the mission God made me to accomplish? What keeps me from telling others the Good News?

group.title: Sharing Your Life Message
group.point: God wants to say something to the world through me.
group.question: As I reflect on my personal story, who does God want me to share it with?

group.title: Becoming a World-Class Christian
group.point: The Great Commission is my commission.
group.question: What steps can I take to prepare to go on a short-term missions experience in the next year?

group.title: Balancing Your Life
group.point: Blessed are the balanced.
group.question: Which of the four activities will I begin in order to stay on track and balance God’s five purposes for my life?

group.title: Living with Purpose
group.point: Living with purpose is the only way to really live.
group.question: When will I take the time to write down my answers to life’s five great questions? When will I put my purpose on paper?

group.title: The Envy Trap
group.point: I cannot fulfill God’s purpose for me if I am envying others.
group.question: In what areas of my life do I most often compare myself with and envy others?

group.title: The People-Pleaser Trap
group.point: Happiness is my choice. I don’t need anyone’s approval to be happy.
group.question: Whose opinion matters most to me? Whose approval am I living for?
